title: Lock screen appearance page should be findable in Appearance & Style section
line: System Settings now has a Lock Screen page under Appearance & Style › Colors & Themes for the lock screen's wallpaper and clock.
explanation: The lock screen's appearance settings (wallpaper, clock, media controls) were only a sub-page of Screen Locking under Security & Privacy, reached through its "Configure Appearance…" button, so people looking in Appearance & Style never found them. The page wasn't a module of its own, so it couldn't be listed anywhere else. The change adds a second, small module, "Lock Screen", under Colors & Themes (next to Splash Screen and Login Screen) that shows the same appearance page, built from the same code; on its own it only loads, saves and resets the appearance settings, never the lock timeout or other Screen Locking options. Screen Locking keeps its button.

commits.message:
kcm: add a Lock Screen page to Colors & Themes

The lock screen wallpaper and clock could only be changed from a button
in Screen Locking, where people looking in Appearance never found them.
Add a Lock Screen page under Colors & Themes with the same settings.

BUG: 505016

media.caption: Colors & Themes on master: no lock screen entry
Colors & Themes now has Lock Screen, opening the lock screen's wallpaper and clock settings
Searching "lock screen" on master finds only Screen Locking
The search now also lists Lock Screen under Appearance & Style
A wallpaper picked on the new page (Altai) shows on the real lock screen
